props.name: source
props.comment: The FK-array field on the current record (e.g. `"tag_ids"`).

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource choices are fetched from (e.g. `"tags"`). A registered resource name.

props.name: lookupKey
props.comment:
The field on the referenced record the values match. `"id"` (default)
resolves the selected records via `getMany`; any other key resolves them
via `getList({ filter: { [lookupKey]: values } })`.

props.name: filter
props.comment: Permanent filter merged OVER the dynamic filter for every choices fetch.

props.name: sort
props.comment: Sort applied to the choices query.

props.name: debounceMs
props.comment: Debounce delay (ms) for filter-driven choices refetches.
